    • Method Detail

      • registerType

        public static DimensionType registerType(String name,
                         int id)
        Registers a shallow DimensionType (only the name without attached Generator) to the system. using a DimensionType like this will not have any effect on the world generation. A default generator, based on the ID will be used. If there is none, the default Minecraft world generator is used.
        Parameters:
        name - The name of the dimension
        id - The id. If the ID is already taken, a unique one is auto-generated

      • registerType

        public static DimensionType registerType(String name,
                         int id,
                         Class<? extends ChunkProviderCustom> cpc)
        Registers a DimensionType with an attached world generator. If a DimensionType like this is used, CanaryMod will substitute the default Minecraft World Generator with the one that has been registered with this DimensionType.
        Parameters:
        name - The name of the dimension
        id - The id. If the ID is already taken, a unique one is auto-generated
        cpc - The Class instance of the custom world generator

      • fromName

        public static DimensionType fromName(String name)

        Parameters:

        Returns:
        DimensionType based on the given name
